youtube.description:
Dadi ne poocha: "Is umar mein behoshi theek rahegi?" 👵
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Dadi, umar se mat dariye — taiyaari kijiye! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Apni saari dawaiyan hospital lekar aaiye aur doctor ko dikhaiye — koi dawa khud band mat kijiye, doctor se poochhiye
✅ Chashma aur hearing aid (sunne ki machine) saath laaiye
✅ Ghar wale paas rahein, pyaar se baat karein aur din-taareekh yaad dilaayein
✅ Operation ke baad kuch din ulajhan (confusion) ho sakti hai — zyaadatar log theek ho jaate hain; kuch ajeeb lage toh doctor ko batayiye

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
